newsitem.title: USA: USDA to close Hawaii Animal Import Center June 30.
newsitem.headline: USDA to close Hawaii Animal Import Center June 30.

text.p: The Hawaii Animal Import Center, based in Honolulu, will close June 30, the U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday.
USDA also said, effective immediately, it would not accept reservations for quarantine space at the facility, as a step to assure it closes on time.

The quarantine station for livestock, poultry and exotic birds and animals is located on Coast Guard property. The Coast Guard plans to vacate the property in fiscal 1998 and has told USDA it also must leave. USDA said there was "minimal quarantine activity" at the site so closure would have little impact on importers.
